title: Failure: referenced column does not exist in dataset
description: A workflow step references a column name that does not exist in the uploaded dataset. This causes a WorkflowValidationError before execution. Common causes: typo in column name, using a display name instead of the actual header, or assuming a column exists based on context. The validator checks all column references before any step is executed.
planner_guidance: Always verify that column names used in steps exactly match the column names listed in the dataset profile. Do not invent or guess column names. If the user refers to a concept (e.g. 'revenue') but the dataset has a different column name (e.g. 'sales'), use the actual dataset column name.

example.error: column 'revenue' not found. Available: region, sales, month.
example.fix: Use the actual column name from the dataset profile. If user said 'revenue', use 'sales' instead.

rag_note: RAG context only assists planning. The validator is the authoritative check for column existence and will reject any reference to a non-existent column regardless of what the RAG context contains.
